people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: So they took away the stone from the place where the dead man was lying. Jesus lifted up his eyes, and said, “Father, I thank you that you listened to me.
translations.bsb: So they took away the stone. Then Jesus lifted His eyes upward and said, “Father, I thank You that You have heard Me.
translations.kjv: Then they took away the stone from the place where the dead was laid. And Jesus lifted up his eyes, and said, Father, I thank thee that thou hast heard me.
translations.asv: So they took away the stone. And Jesus lifted up his eyes, and said, Father, I thank thee that thou heardest me.
